title: conversations.member_replied v1 (event payload)
description: Published by the conversations module once for each outbound message stored for the first time in a conversation of a personal inbox, sent from Campbooks or from the provider's own client (not for a shared inbox, nor for the mail an inbox's first sync reads); the tasks module asks "Done?" of the owner's open Do tasks that came from the conversation. A fact: ids and a time only, never a name, an address, a subject or text. Workspace-scoped; also listed in openapi/events.json.

owner.description: The inbox's personal owner: the member who sent it.
